other-charges: SELECT FIRST 15 M.CVE_CLIE,M.REFER,M.NO_FACTURA,M.NUM_CARGO,M.IMPORTE,M.SIGNO,M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO+COALESCE(D.AMOUNT,0) AS BALANCE,F.CVE_DOC AS INVOICE_BY_REFERENCE,F.STATUS FROM CUEN_M15 M LEFT JOIN (SELECT CVE_CLIE,REFER,NUM_CARGO,SUM(IMPORTE*SIGNO) AS AMOUNT FROM CUEN_DET15 WHERE TRIM(CVE_CLIE)='1515' GROUP BY CVE_CLIE,REFER,NUM_CARGO) D ON D.CVE_CLIE=M.CVE_CLIE AND D.REFER=M.REFER AND D.NUM_CARGO=M.NUM_CARGO LEFT JOIN FACTF15 F ON F.CVE_DOC=M.REFER AND F.CVE_CLPV=M.CVE_CLIE WHERE TRIM(M.CVE_CLIE)='1515' AND M.IMPORTE*M.SIGNO+COALESCE(D.AMOUNT,0)>0.005 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FACTF15 F2 WHERE F2.CVE_DOC=M.NO_FACTURA AND F2.CVE_CLPV=M.CVE_CLIE AND F2.STATUS<>'C')
